claim_assertions.new_definition_lower: Annual FY2025 adjusted expenses are lower under the new definition than under the prior definition.
claim_assertions.ebitda_margin_uses_revenue: The issuer defines adjusted EBITDA margin using total revenue as denominator.
claim_assertions.constant_balance_rate_effect_identified: The supplied statements separately quantify the exact constant-balance rate effect on annual reserve income.

definitions.expense_model: 9MFY denotes the first nine months, annual less Q4. Adjustments retain source signs. Both reported-definition residuals compare recomputed amounts to reported amounts.
definitions.definition_attribution: Positive exclusions reduce expense. Changes are FY2025 less FY2024 and contributions divide by the change in the prior-minus-new definition gap.
definitions.operating_margins: Use exact USD thousand statement amounts. RLDC equals reserve plus other revenue less distribution and other costs. EBITDA margin uses the issuer denominator. No rounding to whole millions.

evidence_policy: Cite sufficient facts and relevant period, unit, definition or scope context for each output. Additional unrelated sections fail evidence. Equivalent reviewed source paths are accepted, without a shortest-citation requirement.
reconciliation_policy: Residuals compare independently supplied observations. Synthetic controls may make reported totals and components disagree. Preserve the discrepancy instead of forcing zero or changing a source observation. Algebraic identity residuals are not requested.
